confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Japanese resort-town prices, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak season for Mt. Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi and room rates vary widely by date and property. The FX value comes from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not read the RBA daily table directly, and the 15 October observation may not be final.
comparable_city_reasoning: Japanese lakeside and mountain resort towns such as Hakone and Nikko, adjusted for the Mt. Fuji day-trip and hiking tourist market, with restaurant prices close to Japanese mid-market norms.
